name: Voices In Space
source:
This story takes place in space at the station of a space company called TSC.
After an unforseen damage, it is up to you and your assistant Jessie to restore communication with the earth and repair the station for the upcoming crew.

[From [url=https://sxrobertvn.itch.io/voices-in-space]Itch.io[/url]]
